result.instructions: Tools for Emailable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many email verification credits do I have left?"; "Show my remaining email checking credits and the account owner's email."; "Do I have enough credits to verify a list of 500 email addresses?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Emailable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run emailable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run emailable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run emailable_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. emailable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: emailable_get_account
tools.title: Get account and credits
tools.description: The Emailable account behind this API key: the owner's email and available_credits. Check it before a large batch. GET /v1/account.

tools.name: emailable_verify_email
tools.title: Verify one email address
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: verifies one email address and uses 1 Emailable credit (a test_ API key spends none). Returns state (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown), reason, score (0-100), and flags: disposable, free, role, accept_all, no_reply, mailbox_full, plus did_you_mean (a typo fix), the detected user/domain/tag, mx_record and smtp_provider. A credit is returned for an unknown result. The call is never retried automatically. If the reply is {status: "try_again"}, the check took longer than the timeout: call again with the same email; repeats within 5 minutes are not charged. Emailable's terms allow verification of opt-in subscribers' addresses. GET /v1/verify.

smtp.description: Run the SMTP step (default true). false is faster but much less accurate.

accept_all.description: Run the accept-all check (default false). It slows the reply.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the result, 2-10 (default 5).

tools.name: emailable_create_batch
tools.title: Create a batch verification
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: starts a bulk verification of up to 5000 email addresses. Emailable takes 1 credit per email when the batch is created, and if the account has too few credits it may charge the account's saved card to buy more. A test_ API key spends nothing. The batch cannot be cancelled here, and the call is never retried: if it fails or times out, check emailable_get_account before trying again, because a retry can charge twice. Returns the batch id; poll it with emailable_get_batch. Emailable's terms allow verification of opt-in subscribers' addresses. POST /v1/batch.

confirm.description: Must be true. It confirms the user agreed to spend 1 credit per email (and a possible card charge for missing credits).

response_fields.description: Only these fields in each result (default: all).

retries.description: Retry mail-server answers for accuracy (default true). false is faster but gives more unknown results.

tools.name: emailable_get_batch
tools.title: Get a batch verification
tools.description: Status and results of a batch made with emailable_create_batch: message, progress (processed/total), reason_counts and total_counts (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown). Batches of up to 1,000 emails also return the results inline in `emails` (30 days). They come in pages: up to `limit` results, fewer if the reply would get too long; ask for the next page with emails_page.next_offset. A bigger batch returns download_file, a temporary link (5 days) to a ZIP of a CSV: share it only with the account owner. Free to call. GET /v1/batch.

partial.description: Include the results so far while the batch is still running (only for batches of up to 1,000 emails).

include_emails.description: Include per-email results (default true). false returns the counts only.

limit.description: Most results per call, 1-1000 (default 100). A reply can hold fewer; use emails_page.next_offset for the next page.
